items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Mr. Ramos played the tenor when I heard him.

ctx.x: Let's make, like they call it like a double bassoon is a great big long, twice as long or something. Uh huh. It wasn't a real low like baritone or anything. What? The sax, the first sax. Oh, that same, alto and the tenor.
The alto along in the... Mr. Ramos played the tenor when I heard him.
I guess the... See, melodies were great in those days.
